games.title: Code Runner
games.description: Complete the coding challenge by writing the correct function.

challenge.title: Sum Up to N
challenge.description: Write a function named sumUpTo(n) that returns the sum of all integers from 1 through n.
challenge.hint: Use a loop or the formula n * (n + 1) / 2.

games.title: Bug Hunter
games.description: Find and fix the broken JavaScript code to complete the task.

challenge.title: Find the Largest Number
challenge.description: Fix the code so it prints the largest number from the array.

games.title: Array Dash
games.description: Race through array logic and return the correct result.

challenge.title: Sort and Filter
challenge.description: Write a function filterAndSort(numbers) that returns only the even numbers sorted ascending.
challenge.hint: Use filter() to keep even numbers, then sort() to order them.

games.title: String Sprint
games.description: Speed through string puzzles and level up your skills.

challenge.title: Reverse the Words
challenge.description: Create a function reverseWords(text) that reverses the word order in a sentence.
challenge.hint: Split the text into words, reverse the array, then join it again.
